events.title: Never Be Alone - New Trailer Coming Soon
events.summary: Hey everyone,We are excited to share that a brand new trailer for Never Be Alone will be released on Friday the 21st at 19:00 Europe time.The trailer was made by UNVRZ and captured on June 1 using a playtest version, so some things may already have changed, improved, or been fixed since then in our newer demo build.We cannot wait to show it to you all and keep building hype for Never Be Alone as we move closer to the demo release in October.Hope to see you all there!
